facts.fact: The PPPC chief executive says the Digital Malawi Acceleration Project's connectivity component, guided by a Commercial Transaction Manual being drafted by Ernst & Young, targets digital connectivity to 2,500 government sites nationwide, including underserved areas.

MWI.note: Only World Bank funding to the government project is stated.
The consultation was on a procurement manual, not a named digital law or policy.
MAREN is named as a project beneficiary; no service stated.
